author: Dall, 1927

note.en: A small top snail, about 1 cm, collected at 25 m off Manzanillo in 2000. WoRMS lists it for Costa Rica. Rarely seen by divers.
note.es: Un caracol trompo pequeño, de 1 cm, recolectado a 25 m frente a Manzanillo en 2000. WoRMS lo registra para Costa Rica. Los buzos rara vez lo ven.

sources.t: GBIF occurrence records, Gandoca to Limón (INBio ATTA survey 1998 to 2003 and museum specimens)

recWhy: Record: GBIF: 2 records, OBIS: 1 record (Manzanillo 2000, 25 m).
